title: Saaas Attack
description: The official Modpack for Saaas Attack
body: **Saaas Attack** is a lightweight essentials modpack designed for smooth and fair gameplay on the server. It includes only the allowed mods that improve performance stability and usability while keeping the vanilla Minecraft experience intact. The pack focuses on helpful client side features without adding new content or changing game balance. It is easy to install beginner friendly and fully compatible with the **Saaas Attack server** for a clean and reliable multiplayer experience.
